semantics: One nonempty line of lowercase Latin words with exactly one space between words, no other spaces, at most 100000 characters excluding the line terminator (public English HTML attests 10^5; upstream flattened 105). Only final suffixes lios/liala, etr/etra, initis/inites determine adjective/noun/verb and masculine/feminine gender. A single valid word is a sentence; otherwise require one gender and adjective* noun verb*. Unique YES/NO; linear suffix/phase oracle checked against independent whole-sentence regular grammars over exhaustive small sequences.
